PROVENANCE / THE HOUSE

A home.
Not a museum.

The furniture has a past. Your stay is still to be written. Palacete Rodrigues is a Portuguese heritage holiday home hosted by Necila Fernandes in Mazal Vaddo, Anjuna.

The collection belongs to everyday life: a lounge to linger in, a pool to return to, a village beyond the door.
